tasks.short: Review technical document completeness and conformance

steps.what: Read the actual project review scope and current technical requirements in {DOCS}, identifying the applicable document checklist and requirement versions.
outputs: Actual review scope and applicable checklist

steps.what: Retrieve the actual technical document versions and supporting attachments from {DOCS} for the scoped review.
Compare actual document identifiers, required attachments and revision fields against the scoped checklist in {DOCS}.
Compare narrative technical content with actual requirement passages in {DOCS}, identifying supported matches, omissions and possible conflicts.

loop.output: Proposed matches and gaps with both source locations
loop.check: Technician checks scope, technical meaning, omissions and contrary evidence against originals
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved interpretation goes to manual review and engineering escalation
loop.why_not_simpler: Native field checks run first, but differently worded technical passages require contextual comparison

steps.what: Review technical documents to ensure completeness and conformance to requirements, verifying actual content and deciding supported findings and engineering escalation needs.
outputs: Verified technician findings and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write and check the actual review findings, source references and unresolved issues in the project review record draft {PROJECT}.
Save the exact checked review record in {PROJECT}.

tasks.design: Configure native packet views and checklist comparisons in {DOCS}; use bounded source-linked reading only for narrative requirements. The technician verifies technical meaning and records actual findings in {PROJECT}, retaining engineering escalation and a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Document fields and narrative requirements are repeatedly compared by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata checks and bounded source-linked comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Technical applicability and incomplete or contradictory evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising engineering implications and limits of the review.

ambition.what: No automatic engineering certification is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less mechanical comparison; technical authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native checklist checks and bounded narrative comparison can assist document review without certifying engineering conformance.

assumptions: Boundary is actual technical review and its existing record. Shares are E1 workflow estimates, not measured engineering baselines.

Technician determines applicable checklist and requirement versions in s1. Existing engineering document processes supply document id, revision, attachment ids and source text; s2 obtains actual packet. Missing metadata means manual completeness checking; unsupported narrative means manual comparison, not assumed compliance.

Test native views and exact checks before a loop. Human technical judgment, source interpretation and new findings remain fully counted. Original document production and engineering certification labour are unchanged outside the savings.
Ordinary completed-record checking supplies the requested save gate without extra self-approval labour; edits void it. Existing runtime and short save earn no saving.
research_questions: Can source-linked comparison expose real gaps without treating a matching phrase as technical compliance?

already_counted.description: Actual scope, residual retrieval and narrative review, full technical judgment, record and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain checklist mappings and audit missed technical conflicts.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual review record checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 40% retrieval + 20 manual field comparison + 20 x 50% narrative assistance = 36 gross less 2 upkeep. Poor metadata or already checked packets may yield zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve actual site, process and monitoring evidence for the environmental permit application from the project system {PROJECT} and source library {DOCS}.
inputs: Existing actual site and process records

steps.what: Read actual application requirements and instructions in {DOCS}, clarifying applicable national requirements and engineering questions rather than inferring permit eligibility.
outputs: Verified application requirements and unresolved questions

steps.what: Verify actual site identities, process descriptions, measurement units, reporting periods and source evidence before selecting application fields.
outputs: Actual verified field and attachment selection

steps.what: Prepare permit applications in {DOCS} by placing actual selected source fields and attachment references into the required application draft.
inputs: Actual verified field and attachment selection from s3

steps.what: Check the completed application packet's actual meaning, figures, units, completeness and unresolved engineering issues, making corrections before the internal engineering handoff.
outputs: Checked exact application packet and engineering recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked environmental application packet in {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked application packet to the verified internal environmental engineer for the existing engineering review through {PROJECT}.
inputs: Exact packet and engineering recipient checked in s5

tasks.design: Configure native project source views and application-field mappings in {DOCS}. The technician reads requirements and verifies actual evidence, reviews the completed packet and separately saves and sends it for engineering review through {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified environmental data and attachment references are repeatedly copied into application forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views and document/form fields.
tasks.still_hard: Scope, source quality and technically justified statements.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing where evidence is insufficient and engineering review is required.

ambition.what: No autonomous permit determination or regulatory submission is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less application assembly; engineering and regulatory authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Source units, reporting scope and national requirements

evidence.claim: Source-field mapping can assemble an environmental application draft while technical interpretation and engineering review stay human.

assumptions: This is the application-preparation branch of the statement's alternatives, including its real engineering handoff. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured baselines. Compliance-review episodes are a separate branch requiring their own pricing.

Existing site and monitoring workflows produce source id, site/process id, measurement period, value, unit, method/version and attachment reference. Their original collection is unchanged and not saved here. Technician retrieves evidence in s1 and verifies actual selection in s3. Missing or narrative-only values require manual form preparation and reduced s4 savings.

Test native form mappings first. No legal assertion, measurement or site description is invented by software. Existing engineering review remains unchanged; no free transferred work or regulatory approval is claimed. No external submission is performed in this preparation task.
Completed-packet checks occur after corrections and bind separate save and internal send. Edits void gates; no added self-approval stage, existing-runtime or save-tail saving.
research_questions: Can native form mappings preserve actual units, periods and attachment versions without asserting unsupported compliance?

already_counted.description: Residual retrieval, requirements, actual source verification, final packet checks and handoff actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain form versions and source-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected application packet checked in s5
Same exact application packet and internal engineer recipient checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 30% source retrieval + 25 actual form assembly = 31 gross less 2 upkeep. Already mapped or poor-source cases yield zero; technical checks and engineering review remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual support-work status and unresolved environmental project issues in {PROJECT} before overseeing the staff.
Observe actual support work and check practical problems, equipment context and work quality within the technician's supervisory scope.
Oversee support staff through actual instruction, problem discussion, coaching and checks of understanding.
outputs: Actual coaching and clarified work issues

steps.what: Decide actual follow-up responsibilities and engineering escalation from observed work and discussion, within existing staff authority.
inputs: Actual observations and discussion from s2-s3

steps.what: Write the actual follow-up assignments in the existing project-board draft {PROJECT}, using established project identifiers and the technician's actual decisions.
Check the completed assignments for actual instruction meaning, responsibility, feasible follow-up and intended staff recipients.
Save the exact checked assignments in {PROJECT}.
Send the exact checked assignment notice to the verified internal support-staff recipients through {PROJECT}.
inputs: Exact checked assignments and recipients from s6

tasks.design: Configure native work-status views and established project-field defaults in {PROJECT}. The technician observes and coaches staff, makes actual responsibility decisions and checks the completed existing assignment record before separate save and internal notice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work context and repeated project identifiers are manually located during supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views and verified identifier defaults.
tasks.still_hard: Real work quality, understanding and proportionate staff direction.

ambition.what: No automated staff allocation or performance scoring is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less clerical preparation; staff authority remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Technical scope and clear evidence-based handoffs

evidence.claim: Native project views and existing identifier defaults can support supervision without replacing actual observation and coaching.

assumptions: Conditional cycle includes actual supervision with follow-up already recorded on a project board; no formal performance report or per-conversation administration is invented. Shares are E1 estimates.

Existing work processes supply project id, actual work status and unresolved issue references. Staff input work records as before; no extra unpaid reporting is introduced. Technician produces observations in s2, actual discussion in s3 and real responsibility decisions in s4. Missing status requires human checks, not inferred completion.

Test native views first. s5 only reduces repeated identifiers and headings, not new instructions or staff decisions. Actual staff work and other supervisors' labour are unchanged. No algorithm selects workers or evaluates traits.
Ordinary completed-assignment checks supply requested gates with no added self-approval stage; edits void them. Save and notice remain short fully retained actions, with no existing-runtime saving.
research_questions: Can native views reduce context lookup without encouraging invented status or additional staff reporting?

already_counted.description: Residual context lookup, actual observation, coaching, decisions, substantive assignments, checks and actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain project views and assignment field defaults.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed assignments checked in s6
Same exact assignments and internal recipients checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 40% context retrieval + 8 x 20% repeated identifiers = 5.6 gross less 1 upkeep. Existing efficient views yield zero; supervision retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review work plans and schedule activities

steps.what: Review work plans to schedule activities, reading the actual environmental work scope, dependencies and engineering restrictions in {DOCS}.
Clarify actual site access, equipment availability and staff or engineering dependencies with responsible people before deciding scheduling constraints.
Capture the actual activity durations, predecessor links, permissible windows and fixed resource choices in the schedule draft {PROJECT}.
Construct a proposed activity schedule from the actual captured parameters in {PROJECT}, showing dependency and availability conflicts explicitly.
outputs: Completed proposed schedule and conflict list

steps.what: Check and correct the completed schedule against actual work-plan meaning, access, resources, dependencies and intended project audience, resolving conflicts with human judgment.
outputs: Checked exact feasible schedule and audience

steps.what: Save the exact checked activity schedule in {PROJECT}.
Publish the exact checked activity schedule to the verified internal project audience in {PROJECT}.
inputs: Exact saved schedule and audience checked in s5

tasks.design: Configure native dependencies, calendars and conflict views in {PROJECT} before custom scheduling code. The technician reads the real plan, verifies and captures actual constraints, then checks the completed proposal before separate save and publication; software does not infer availability or decide engineering priorities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity dates are manually laid out and cross-checked against known constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain site conditions and deciding how to resolve genuine conflicts.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the work and negotiating realistic constraints.

ambition.what: No autonomous work dispatch or staffing decision is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less mechanical scheduling; work priorities and authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native project scheduling can lay out activities from explicit actual constraints while humans retain engineering priorities and exception decisions.

assumptions: Conditional baseline has actual manual date layout; shares are E1 workflow estimates. Already automatically scheduled plans earn no saving.

Technician reads actual plans in s1, obtains real availability in s2 and captures activity id, duration, predecessor, allowed window and fixed resource choice in s3. Other people's existing calendars are unchanged inputs, not newly demanded reporting. Missing or uncertain constraints stay manual and must not be guessed by software.

Test native scheduling first. No worker ranking, performance-based allocation or autonomous equipment control. s4 only proposes dates from existing actual parameters; s5 keeps full conflict judgment and meaning checks.

Final correction precedes the exact-version gates; edits invalidate them. Planned dates never establish completed work. Save and publication retain their real short time, with no existing-runtime saving.
research_questions: Can native scheduling reproduce actual work constraints while flagging missing inputs and leaving conflict resolution human?

already_counted.description: Actual plan review, availability discussion, parameter capture, full schedule review and actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain calendars, dependency mappings and conflict tests.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected schedule checked in s5
Same exact corrected schedule and internal audience checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25 actual manual schedule-layout points removed less 2 upkeep = 23 net. Existing automation or missing constraints yields zero; plan review, capture and conflict judgment retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Technical interpretation, staff supervision and scheduling judgment remain human.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who reduces mechanical document and schedule assembly while retaining real technical checks, staff oversight and engineering escalation.
